'''Vincine''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] as a [[Sith Inquisitor]]. Vincine wore black and red robes and carried a purple [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], and he was selected by [[Darth Malgus]] to join a strike team consisting of [[Rotham]], [[Kyrenic]], and [[Andan]] with the purpose of capturing the ''[[Allusis]]''.<ref name="Red Reaper" />
